S&P daily chart – Higher low pullbacks are the name of the game. If the market just extends the rally, 610 is a measured move.

S&P hourly chart – NOTHING bearish about the price action, I'm just using this view to talk about the only two short ideas that would be somewhat reasonable. Look above and fail on the all time high or a move into the election gap. Both have well defined R:R, but are counter trend.

Market internals – Reads got weaker as the breakout extended into Thursday and Friday. It doesn't mean to short the market, but rather keep an open mind to bullish consolidation after the large expansion of range. None of the internals were inherently bearish.

Market profile – Friday's session stays clean over the Thursday value area. Decent excess at the highs and lows. Stronger sellers would have attempted a value area overlap for more of a balanced look. Didn't happen.
